_comment: The products OIO actually sells. A design is artwork; a product is that artwork on one blank we chose. `primary` is the one card that represents a design inside its category — the rest surface through 'Also on' on the product page.
_scope: T-shirts only for now. Hoodies and long sleeves were dropped 2026-08-12: only 12 of the 31 designs ever had their product range enabled, so those categories were empty for everything else and enabling them by hand is slow, error-prone work in the Partner Area. Every design already has a tee, so a tees-only shelf is complete on day one. The dropped entries are kept below under `_parked` so restoring them is an edit, not a re-derivation.
_productTypeIdsNote: A list, tried in order, first one the design actually carries wins. A single `productTypeId` still works and means exactly that blank. The list exists because the 19 designs that were never given a product range each sit on whichever tee they were uploaded onto — 210 or 812 — while the twelve full-range designs carry 175. Demanding one specific blank would have excluded two thirds of the catalogue for no customer-visible reason: they are all unisex tees.

5d89f20f13615160bf833e7d._why: Art is a black print on the Bella + Canvas blank, which has no light-ink version. Gildan Heavyweight Unisex carries an E5E5E5 print, so the design can run white on black.

5d89f19b162c5f464e875bc1._why: Bella + Canvas has no yellow garment. Men's Premium T-Shirt stocks sun yellow and carries the black print. Relabelled because that blank is a men's cut, not a unisex one.

5d89f1b5f937647d8113d138._why: Light line art with a dark red 'FX16' wordmark, and no single ink token for the contrast rule to measure. Checked against real renders: red drowns the wordmark, navy and olive muddy it, olive also washes out the outline. Black is the only colourway that carries both parts.

5d89f1b51cbf3a25d5a8c6f8._why: Toyota Corolla KE70 — bold black/white/red graphic. Checked against real renders: true red (the shop default) buried the car outline in the garment colour. Black and white both work; black picked to bias toward dark garment / light art.

5d89f1f813615160bf83367f._why: Toyota Celica Cutaway — Ian's call, overriding the earlier white pick: black by default.

5d89f1b52051762642221a8c._why: Starion Conquest — Ian's call, overriding the earlier black pick: a light shirt (white) by default.

5d89f20e20517626422245b0._why: AE86 Corolla Hatchback — dark charcoal gear graphic. Checked against real renders: it disappears on black, navy and the light-heather-gray default alike. The ink is dark, so it needs a light ground; white is the crispest of the light options.

5d89f1f71cbf3a25d5a8e5c1._why: Aschwanden Spark Plug — fine dark line-art blueprint. Checked against real renders: the detail goes muddy on black/navy/true red. Needs a light ground for the linework to stay legible.

5d89f1e06bbdbb2e6a5b4eb0._why: Toyota Tosco Brochure Art — Ian's call: olive by default. Blank 210 has no colour literally named "olive"; military green (#6E7C54) is the closest match in the same family.

5d89f20e162c5f464e8791cc._why: S Generations (Color Car) — red car line art. Checked against real renders: it disappears on the true-red default's sibling problem and is muted on light heather gray; it's vivid on black. Matched across all three S Generations versions for consistency.
